versions.content: Three non-abstract classes derived from AutosarDataPro- totype There are three non-abstract classes derived from AutosarDataProto- type which reflect the main use cases in the SWC-Template: • Operation arguments ( ArgumentDataPrototype ) in a client-server interface. • Variables ( VariableDataPrototype ) which are changed by the application software at runtime. • Parameters ( ParameterDataPrototype ) which are constant (except for cali- bration access) from the application point of view.
